slides.sub: How New Jersey's state down payment assistance program works.

slides.label: NJHMFA down payment assistance
slides.body: The amount is based on the county where the home you're buying is located.

slides.label: How it's structured
slides.body: It's an interest-free second loan with no monthly payment, forgivable over five years.

slides.title: First-time buyers
slides.body: You count as first-time if you haven't owned a home in the previous three years. The home must be your primary residence, and household income and purchase price limits apply.

slides.title: With an NJHMFA first mortgage
slides.body: It must be paired with a 30-year, fixed-rate FHA, VA or USDA loan through NJHMFA. Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.

caption:
Buying your first home in New Jersey? The state's down payment assistance program offers up to $15,000.

The amount is based on the county where you buy. It's an interest-free, five-year forgivable second loan with no monthly payment. You count as first-time if you haven't owned a home in the previous three years, the home must be your primary residence, and income and purchase price limits apply. It must be paired with a 30-year, fixed-rate FHA, VA or USDA loan through NJHMFA.

Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.
